dependencies: whole unchanged sm_80.c bank; retained DecompressToMem and DecompNextByte

memory.reads: immutable ROM bytes and sequential byte-addressed WRAM backreferences
memory.mapping: LoROM (((bank << 15) | (address & 32767)) & 4194303); low-half and outside loaded extent rejected
memory.word_access: explicit little-endian byte operations; unaligned addresses allowed

numeric.source: u32 cursor; increment then add 32768 after low word FFFF; reads require 24-bit address
numeric.destination: bounded absolute WRAM offsets; signed C backreferences must remain within WRAM
numeric.length: short 1..32; extended 1..1024; FF terminates before header decode
numeric.fill: u8 wrapping; word alternation may end on first byte
numeric.copy: sequential overlapping byte reads and stores, never memcpy

exclusions: This initial fixture suite exercises short literal and terminator only and is partial
Malformed/unbounded C streams are excluded from oracle execution; Rust reports errors
No original-ROM parity, ordered-store equivalence, live ABI or whole-game Rust ownership
